game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: KFCKFC
quote: Although GTA 6 offers impressive graphics and a detailed open world, it may not live up to everyone's expectations. The gameplay could become repetitive, and the story might feel too predictable. Additionally, the high price and long development time may disappoint some fans. Overall, GTA 6 looks promising, but it still has to prove that it can surpass its predecessor.
